changes.label: EPA refinements
changes.definition: Finite-mass flux, alpha-constant adjustment and stable angular sampler together; the Born normalization is already corrected in both arms.

changes.label: EPA spatial profile
changes.definition: Change the transverse placement prescription at fixed finite-mass EPA treatment.

changes.label: Full treatment, ring
changes.definition: Change hard amplitudes, proposal support, exact kinematics, virtuality and identical-lepton treatment together; the common placement rule does not imply an identical sampled spatial distribution.

changes.label: Full treatment, profile
changes.definition: Change the full hard-process and phase-space treatment while retaining the profile placement rule.

changes.label: Full-QED spatial profile
changes.definition: Change the placement prescription within the full-QED calculation.

changes.label: Electron-mass cutoff
changes.definition: Apply Q squared no greater than electron mass squared within EPA; this does not implement the complete CAIN spatial model.

changes.label: Remove suppression, EPA
changes.definition: Disable finite transverse beam-size suppression within EPA.

changes.label: Remove suppression, full
changes.definition: Disable finite transverse beam-size suppression within full QED.

changes.label: Expand domain
changes.definition: Double both transverse extents and cell counts while keeping cell spacing fixed.

estimator: Ratio of summed admitted daughter counts to summed inclusive electron-positron luminosity
qualification: Four-seed sampling SEMs only. Cross-arm covariance is measured; no independent-row Poisson term or calibrated global significance is inferred.

profile_interaction.label: Model/profile interaction
profile_interaction.definition: (full profile - full ring) - (EPA profile - EPA ring)
profile_interaction.qualification: Difference-in-differences with measured paired covariance; controls need not be additive.

model_scope: All arms use unpolarized real photons. Legacy EPA already has corrected Born normalization. Full-QED BH/LL do not use the EPA hard pair_q2 veto.
population_scope: Admitted electron/positron daughters only; 5 MeV production cut, pair_ratio=1, no final recut and no scattered spectators. Exact daughter assignment follows the minimum-virtuality spectator rule.
domain_scope: Expanded extents change field/source coverage and virtual-photon acceptance together, at fixed transverse cell spacing. beam_size=0 places photons locally; it does not model infinite beams.
